strings.site.description: Freally Teleprompt is a teleprompter for Windows, macOS and Linux that reads at a real human pace — characters per second or BPM — and marks every pause you write. No account, no telemetry. Free today; future versions may be sold.
strings.footer.licence: Proprietary — All Rights Reserved. © Mike Weaver. Free to use today; future versions may be sold. Not open source.
strings.footer.yours: Your scripts are yours. They stay on your computer, and the app's author never receives, stores or relays them.
